VAR __LastFinalDemandDateWithData = CALCULATE( MAX('Producer Price Index'[Date] ), ALL('Producer Price Index' ))
VAR __EOMLastDate = EOMONTH( __LastFinalDemandDateWithData, 0 )

RETURN
    'Date'[Date] <= __EOMLastDate

VAR __LastDateWithData = CALCULATE( MAX('Durable Goods'[Date] ), ALL('Durable Goods' ))
VAR __EOMLastDate = EOMONTH( __LastDateWithData, 0 )

RETURN
    'Date'[Date] <= __EOMLastDate
